initial_scene: An elevated forward-facing view shows both robot forearms over a table. The left hand is already holding the upper edge of an open brown paper bag; the right hand is open beside a two-tier fruit shelf. The sole red spherical tomato on the upper black tray is distinct from the fruit in the lower white tray.

observed_sequence.action: The left hand holds the bag edge steady while the right hand remains open beside the shelf.
The right arm raises its open hand toward the red tomato on the upper black tray; the left hand continues holding the bag.
The right fingers surround and close on the tomato in the upper tray.
The right hand lifts the tomato fully clear of the black tray.
The right hand transports the tomato toward the open bag. The left hand raises the bag edge to keep its mouth open.
The right hand lowers the tomato through the bag opening; the tomato becomes occluded by the bag and hands.
The right hand opens its fingers within the bag mouth and is visibly empty at the end. The left hand retains the bag edge.

arm_hand_roles.right_hand: Grasps the tomato from the upper tray, lifts and transports it, lowers it into the bag, then opens its fingers.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: The left hand maintains access to the bag interior as the right hand inserts the tomato; no hand-to-hand object transfer occurs.
